cohort: 163 women who underwent hysterectomy for benign conditions at the University Teaching Hospital in Yaoundé, Cameroon, from 2000 to 2008
finding: Less than a quarter of hysterectomies for benign conditions were performed vaginally, with age less than 50 years, previous laparotomy/cesarean section, premenopausal status, and fibroid as surgical indication being independently associated with the choice of abdominal route.
